findings.chapter: Ch. 3 — Understanding the Model (§3.6.2); recurrence in Ch. 5 fn. 3–4, Ch. 7 §7.3.2, §7.3.3
findings.evidence: "at about 27B total and about 14B active parameters as published (Wan2.2 source, pinned revision 1ea34ff, retrieved 2026-10-28)" (PDF p. 72). Contrast Ch 2 §2.1.2 (PDF p. 44), same source: "pinned revision 1ea34ff, retrieved 2026-10-28 — post-cutoff addendum v20260913+addendum-20261028". Preface policy (PDF p. 21): "a separately dated 2026-10-28 technology notes in the body and Appendix A carry revision v20260913+addendum-20261028".
findings.issue: Inconsistent application of the book's own post-cutoff labeling rule. The Preface states that dated 2026-10-28 notes carry the revision identifier v20260913+addendum-20261028, and Ch 2 §2.1.2 and Ch 7 §7.3.1 do carry it. But other 2026-10-28 citations omit the identifier: Ch 3 §3.6.2 (Wan2.2, PDF p. 72), Ch 5 footnote 3 (PDF pp. 119–120) and footnote 4 (PDF p. 130) — these say "post-cutoff addendum" but no revision ID — Ch 7 §7.3.2 ("released configuration, retrieved 2026-10-28", PDF p. 162), and Ch 7 §7.3.3 ("GGUF specification, pinned revision, retrieved 2026-10-28", PDF p. 166). The addendum revision identifier is the reader's only anchor into the Edition-history addendum log, so the omission breaks the traceability the policy promises — notably for the identical Wan2.2 source that Ch 2 tags and Ch 3 does not.
findings.fix_instruction: Add "v20260913+addendum-20261028" to every dated 2026-10-28 citation (Ch 3 §3.6.2; Ch 5 fn. 3–4; Ch 7 §7.3.2; Ch 7 §7.3.3), or narrow the Preface rule to name exactly which notes carry the identifier.
